summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of Omnisys Ltd., an Israeli company, for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $196.6 million in common stock. The consideration includes shares valued at $25.52 million (2,726,494 shares) issued at closing, $3.48 million (371,794 shares) placed into escrow, $142.5 million payable in five equal stock installments over five years, and the balance on the 24th trading day post-closing. Sellers are subject to a daily trading volume limitation of 15% of the 10-day average daily volume. The board recommended the transaction; no advisor named. Watch for Nasdaq compliance and selling pressure from the volume-restricted stock.
